name: Survey tile in Gemini
blurb: A 0.3 degree patch 1.1 degrees north of the ecliptic in Gemini, imaged by SPHEREx 25 times in 7 visits over 73 hours. Picked automatically by the survey because it was imaged often enough to follow a moving object.
summary_plain: 50 SPHEREx images of this patch taken over 3.1 days starting 2026-03-16, at wavelengths from 0.87 to 4.97 µm. The pipeline found 1 moving object.
